designNotes: Permission matrix: for each module, the lowest role granted and the highest role refused (GYM-RBAC seeded roles).
Two channels per refusal: the menu (hidden) and a direct URL (refused).
Field masking: phone hidden for Marketing on a screen and in an export.

cases.title: A role without the Configuration permission sees no Configuration menu

steps.action: Sign in as Receptionist and open the main menu
steps.expected: The main menu has no "Cấu hình" entry

steps.action: Sign in as Admin and open the main menu
steps.expected: The main menu shows a "Cấu hình" entry

testConditions: Configuration: Admin granted, every other role refused

cases.title: A direct URL to a module without permission is refused

steps.action: Sign in as Receptionist and type the Configuration URL in the address bar
steps.expected: The configuration page is refused (no settings are shown) and the API answers 403 for its data

testConditions: Configuration URL as a refused role

cases.title: Marketing never sees customer phone numbers on screen

steps.action: Sign in as Marketing and open the lead analysis report
steps.expected: No customer phone number appears in the report; the phone column is empty or masked

testConditions: Field masking: phone hidden for Marketing

cases.title: A masked field stays masked in an Excel export
preconditions: A custom role with customer.export and the phone field hidden

steps.action: As a role with phone hidden and an export permission, export a customer list to Excel
steps.expected: The exported file has no phone numbers: the phone column is empty or masked
steps.testData: A custom role with customer.export and phone hidden

testConditions: Export of a list for a role with phone hidden
cases.manualReason: Opening and inspecting a downloaded Excel file is outside the browser steps the executor runs.
